'''Bells''' was a [[Nomai]] from [[Brittle Hollow]] who guided Nomai pilgrims on their [[Quantum Moon]] pilgrimage, helping [[Solanum]] in particular.<ref>BELLS: If you’re here to make your first pilgrimage to the Quantum Moon, you are almost prepared to set out on this deeply significant journey.</ref><ref>BELLS: That’s exciting! You’re almost ready, but there’s still one more rule you need to learn. Come see me at the Tower of Quantum Knowledge.</ref> The notes Bells left to Solanum and other pilgrims can be found throughout Brittle Hollow's [[Tower of Quantum Knowledge]].
